title: Integral mean estimates for $(α,β)$-harmonic functions
summary: We establish sharp $L^p$ integral mean estimates for $(α,β)$-harmonic functions on the unit disk. Explicit bounds for the functions and their partial derivatives are obtained in terms of boundary data, by means of the associated Poisson-type kernel and hypergeometric function representations. As applications, we derive coefficient estimates and Hardy space-type results, extending well-known inequalities for classical harmonic and $α$-harmonic functions to the $(α,β)$-harmonic setting.
